name: Proposal Supervision Loss
definition: A loss function that supervises the proposal MLP by minimizing excess histogram mass that violates a bound established between histograms of 1D data, encouraging consistency between proposal weights $(\hat{t}, \hat{w})$ and NeRF weights $(t, w)$ despite different bin locations.
summary: Proposal Supervision Loss is a regularization term that enforces consistency between proposal and NeRF networks by bounding NeRF weights with proposal weights, differing from photometric losses by operating on rendering weights rather than pixel colors.
